mapper.sql: select s.id, s.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, s.material_id, s.material_batch_id,s.material_name, s.quantity, s.inbound_quantity, s.outbound_quantity, s.expiry_date, s.qr_code, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at, iod.material_type, iod.agricultural_input_type, iod.variety from stock s left join inv_warehouse w on s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0' left join inbound_order_detail iod on s.material_batch_id = iod.batch_no
mapper.select: select count(distinct material_id) as material_count, sum(quantity) as total_quantity, sum(inbound_quantity) as total_inbound, sum(outbound_quantity) as total_outbound from stock where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and status = 'active'

select s.material_id, count(distinct s.warehouse_id) as warehouse_count, sum(s.quantity) as total_quantity, sum(s.inbound_quantity) as total_inbound, sum(s.outbound_quantity) as total_outbound from stock s where s.material_id = #{materialId} and s.status = 'active' group by s.material_id
select * from stock where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and material_id = #{materialId} and quantity > 0 and status = '0' and (expiry_date is null or expiry_date > curdate()) order by created_at
